title: sqliteBinding
responsibility: Converts a model field value to a SQLite binding, serializing JSON and booleans and rejecting incompatible values.

inputs.name: sqliteBinding.value
inputs.description: The application value to encode; JSON values are serialized and null is encoded for JSON fields or accepted for nullable fields.

inputs.name: sqliteBinding.field
inputs.description: The model field's SQLite storage type and nullability rules.

outputs.name: sqliteBinding
outputs.description: A string, number, byte array or null suitable for a prepared-statement binding; booleans become 0 or 1 and JSON becomes text.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Raised when the supplied value cannot be encoded for its declared field type.
